answer: The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in atlas, expire in island, and grove lists each expiry. Anyone running 182 aliases hence needs 121 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4381 identities would post 2310 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
